ToDegrees(double)

Converts a radian value to degrees.

public static double ToDegrees(this double value)

Parameters

value double

The radian value to convert.

Returns

double

The converted value in degrees.

Examples

double radians = Math.PI / 2;
Console.WriteLine(radians.ToDegrees()); // Output: 90

ToFixed(double, int)

Rounds a double value to a specified number of decimal places.

public static double ToFixed(this double value, int dp = 2)

Parameters

value double

The double value to round.

dp int

The number of decimal places to round to. Defaults to 2.

Returns

double

The rounded double value.

Examples

double num = 123.45678;
Console.WriteLine(num.ToFixed(2)); // Output: 123.46

ToRadians(double)

Converts a degree value to radians.

public static double ToRadians(this double value)

Parameters

value double

The degree value to convert.

Returns

double

The converted value in radians.

Examples

double degrees = 90;
Console.WriteLine(degrees.ToRadians()); // Output: 1.5707963267948966 (PI/2)

Wrap180(double)

Wraps a degree value to the range -180 to +180, typically used for longitude.

public static double Wrap180(this double value)

Parameters

value double

The degree value to wrap.

Returns

double

The wrapped degree value.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(181.0.Wrap180());  // Output: -179
Console.WriteLine((-181.0).Wrap180()); // Output: 179

Wrap360(double)

Wraps a degree value to the range 0 to 360, typically used for bearings.

public static double Wrap360(this double value)

Parameters

value double

The degree value to wrap.

Returns

double

The wrapped degree value.

Examples

Console.WriteLine(361.0.Wrap360()); // Output: 1
Console.WriteLine((-1.0).Wrap360());  // Output: 359

Wrap90(double)
